testcase.name: the measured history numbers are restated for the record()
the retired ISIN still resolves to a live company rather than to nothing()
a disappearance is never turned into a guess about where the ticker went()
the new leg is detected as SYMBOL_APPEARED and never as a return()
the tracker emits SYMBOL_DISAPPEARED on the session after the last row()
a short absence is a blip and emits no resume event()
the retired ticker exists in neither source which is the whole problem()
the resolver turns the dead ticker into a usable live symbol with a full explanation()
a tracker fed the real bhavcopy plus the real master agrees that TMCV and TMPV are unremarkable()
the tracker records an ISIN change as a relisting and offers it as an alias()
both demerger legs trade today with the ISINs quoted in the alias table()
the reconciliation of the real pair does not mistake the demerger for a mismatch()
a real RESUMED_AFTER_GAP fires when the retired symbol comes back()
